summary:
PLAY13 cargo modal clarity, presentation only. New test-cargo-choice-ui.js (6 node:test cases) loads real BackstageUI in a VM with minimal DOM/scene plumbing and drives real BackstageUI.perform over real B.create/restore/command and BackstageAuto. Genuine RED was recorded first on untouched adopted backstage-ui.js: all 6 tests failed on missing held counts/slot load/one-item wording (old grouped labels such as '放下封口艾尔', body '

放下的东西会落在街区…

') while grouping, first-seen order, no-mutation and real drop mechanics already passed. Then only the `if(verb==='cargo'){` branch in backstage-ui.js changed: body now states live used/capacity slots from B.load(r) and B.KITS[r.kit].capacity plus piece count with an explicit slots-vs-pieces distinction; one option per held kind in original bag first-seen order (Map built by iterating r.bag, no sort/mutation) with label '放下 1 件 · 持有 N 件' and description giving per-item weight, explicit single-item wording, and exact slots freed; callback identity kept as this.perform('cargo-drop:'+firstSeenId) with secondary:true; safe first choice '先都留着，继续探索' has no run; paragraph facts retained (lands in street, no immediate cash, one salvage for greenhouse pump). cargo-drop routing, all key handlers, render/frame and other verbs untouched; no CSS/scene/core/auto/save changes. After change: new tests 6/6 GREEN and old district suites 29/29 GREEN; both node --check pass. Coverage includes duplicate bottles with first-seen id drop (item4 dropped while item0 remains; reopen shows 1 then 0), hook/cart/foam load math, mixed bottle/hops/barrel/salvage/parcel five-kind fixture with exact full TYPES names, no state change on open/cancel, empty bag keep-only modal, auto capacity drop routing through A.choose and resuming take to parcel, ordinary auto drop via real B.command with unchanged routing, and B.restore identity checks. Real browser/Escape/390x844 layout and natural seed play remain parent acceptance.
